title: Occlusal vertical dimension estimated from 3-dimensional facial scans using a craniometric equation: A retrospective clinical study
html: Establishing an appropriate occlusal vertical dimension (OVD) is a critical and challenging step in complete mouth rehabilitation, particularly in patients with severe tooth wear or edentulism. Although craniometric equations have been proposed to estimate OVD from facial measurements, their applicability to 3-dimensional (3D) facial scans within digital workflows remains unclear.
